results.title: Lebanon's Army: Dreaming of an Elusive Joy
results.description: Lebanon marked Army Day on August 1. On this day in 1945, France - the mandatory power over Syria and Lebanon since 1920 - handed the military units under its control in the Levant to the national government of independent Lebanon. Yet, the occasion falls this year under abnormal circumstances. One might object that independent Lebanon has rarely known "normal circumstances," which is true, but the present moment is exceptional in every respect.
